verdict.rationale: Automatic anomaly or policy flagging is a fair axis for a business payments account, but the evidence shows no AI-driven or automatic flagging of anomalous or out-of-policy transactions for review. The closest items are adjacent: spend-control rules that permit or block card transactions by MCC or currency, card transaction retrieval APIs, and webhooks that a developer could use to build such flagging. None of these is the product itself flagging transactions for review.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
